description: Validate post content against platform-specific constraints before creating a post. Checks text length, media counts, file types, aspect ratios, and other platform rules. Returns valid (bool), errors (blocking issues), and warnings (non-blocking). Provide either platforms (by name) or account_ids (resolved to platforms). Use this before social_api_create_post to catch issues early.

account_ids.description: Connected account IDs — platforms are resolved from these. Provide either platforms or account_ids.

platforms.description: Platform names to validate against (e.g. instagram, facebook). Provide either platforms or account_ids.

name: social_api_validate_post
title: Validate Post
